name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.279.0 — Prototype replay on split contracts and separate web boots: the build driver derives REPLAY only for the spec whose File Plan owns prototype.e2eFile ({stem} substituted) — the row /spec:plan already gives exactly one spec per contract — so sibling slices of one contract go straight to COMMIT with a one-line skip notice, refuse --mark replayed, and record replay:{owner:false}; review-legs appends no contract leg for them, so a stray [oracle: contract] AC on a sibling still reads absent. That row is no longer a wave row (the driver copies it at --mark replayed). The grounding contract gains optional prototype.bootCommand (falls back to runtime.bootCommand), printed by the REPLAY, ROUND and TESTS steps, for hosts whose smoke boot is an API-only process beside a web build; prototype-driver check flags a host with neither. Seen in prax-app spec 20261028/02; pinned by build-driver-replay.test.js plus contract-leg and prototype-driver cases. 7.278.0 — Lock refuses a shared spec number: /spec:plan's lock step 2 now runs spec-number-check against the host root before any other lint and refuses the lock on exit 1 — a parallel plan that already took this draft's number means the author renames the draft to the next free number and rewrites its AC-IDs by hand, never an auto-renumber. The guard ran only from /spec:doctor check 18 before, so two parallel plans could both lock the same NN and mint the same AC-IDs (class prefix-collision-coverage-fail-open, 5 in the fleet ledger). Pinned by the entrypoint manifest and a lock-time shape test (one draft beside one hardened spec on the same number is refused). 7.277.0 — One tests-row check: lib/file-plan.js exports isTestsRow and every script that decides whether a File Plan row is a tests row calls it, so a row spelled Test is now seen by red-check, ac-matrix and collision-closure the same way build dispatches it; a consistency test bans inline copies. /spec:doctor check 19 (Fixed ports and host command shape) adds two advisory port-check hints: config-compound-boot for a compound runtime.bootCommand and config-no-test-count for a host without capabilities.testCountPattern.
